info.title: Autonomous CFO API
info.description: Liquidity agent: forecast, credit facility proposal, simulated decision and explanations from a model served on OpenShift AI.

get.description: Liveness of the app process. Model health is checked separately.
Reachability of the configured OpenShift AI primary and fallback models.

schema.title: Response Health Ai Health Ai Get

post.description: Compute 14 end-of-day balances including start_date from a UTF-8 CSV with the header id,date,amount_minor,label. The opening balance comes before any start_date movement. Rows outside the window don't move the balance and are returned unchanged in transactions. first_deficit is the first strictly negative day. When the baseline goes below zero, proposal is a credit facility whose limit is the deepest gap, max(0, -min(balances)); the earliest day wins a tie. earlier_payments lists incoming payments that would shrink the facility if collected earlier. Send move_transaction_id and move_to_date together to move one incoming payment inside the window: scenario then holds that projection and the baseline and proposal stay unchanged. The response echoes the currency. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

422.description: Invalid CSV, fields, currency, transaction ID or scenario date. detail is a readable message, with the CSV line number where it applies.

post.description: Simulate the owner's decision on the proposed facility. The server recalculates the limit from the baseline. Approved: each day uses up to the limit to cover a negative balance and reports what is still uncovered. Rejected: the original gap stays uncovered. Balances are returned unchanged. Nothing is applied for, transferred or sent. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

422.description: Unknown decision, a baseline that isn't 14 consecutive days, or a baseline without a shortfall

post.description: Explain the proposal with the model served on OpenShift AI and draft an editable payment reminder. The server recalculates the proposal, gives the model only formatted facts, and rejects an answer whose amounts aren't those facts or that misses the first gap, the deepest gap or the limit. It retries once, then tries the fallback model. Demo mode returns demo/advice.example.json. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

422.description: Invalid request, or a baseline with no shortfall to explain

503.description: The model is unavailable, timed out, or its answer didn't match the calculated figures after a retry and the fallback model. The forecast and proposal stay valid.

post.description: The advice answer plus a warning about how a client's historical payment delay would change the gap. The delayed limit is calculated in Python; the model only words it. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

503.description: The model is unavailable, timed out, or its answer didn't match the calculated figures after a retry and the fallback model. The forecast and proposal stay valid.

post.description: Simulate sending the reminder draft. Nothing is sent: the owner copies the draft and sends it from their own email. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

200.description: Simulated send, status is always simulated

post.description: Recalculate the deepest gap when incoming payments arrive 3 or 5 days later, outgoing payments are 10% higher, or both, and suggest a limit with a buffer for the worst case. Deterministic, no model. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

Ways to need less credit, best first: collect an invoice earlier or pay a bill later. Wages, taxes, social insurance and loan repayments are never moved. Deterministic, no model. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

200.description: Ranked payment moves with the limit each one leaves

post.description: Score the proposed facility from 100 down, one deduction per risk with its reason. The points are an illustrative scorecard, not a bank's credit model. The model explains the calculated score. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

422.description: Invalid request, or a baseline without a shortfall

503.description: The model is unavailable, timed out, or its answer didn't match the calculated figures after a retry and the fallback model. The forecast and proposal stay valid.

post.description: Answer the owner's question about the forecast. If the question changes one transaction (amount or date), Python recalculates the forecast first; the model answers only from calculated facts. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

200.description: Answer and the recalculated what-if, if any

503.description: The model is unavailable, timed out, or its answer didn't match the calculated figures after a retry and the fallback model. The forecast and proposal stay valid.

post.description: Flag unusual payments: same-day spikes, outlier expenses and duplicate payments. The findings are calculated in Python; in live mode the model writes the summary. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

Compare ways to cover the gap: the credit facility with its estimated interest, invoice factoring, or deferring a bill. Costs are calculated in Python; in live mode the model explains the recommendation. Every request takes an optional currency: EUR (default), PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SEK or DKK. Amounts are integer minor units (1 unit = 100) in that currency; the app never converts.

200.description: Options with estimated cost and the recommended one

AdviceRequest.title: AdviceRequest
AdviceRequest.description:
The baseline and transactions from the forecast response.

The server recalculates the proposal from them, so the model always explains
the deterministic figures.

CreditCheckResponse.title: CreditCheckResponse
CreditCheckResponse.description: A transparent scorecard for the proposed facility. The score is calculated; the model only explains it.

DecisionResponse.title: DecisionResponse
DecisionResponse.description: Outcome of a simulated human decision. Nothing is applied for, sent or moved.

EarlierPayment.title: EarlierPayment
EarlierPayment.description: An incoming payment that would shrink the proposed facility if the client paid it by pay_by.

InsightRequest.title: InsightRequest
InsightRequest.description: The baseline and transactions from the forecast response. Every figure is recalculated from them.

PaymentOptimizationResponse.title: PaymentOptimizationResponse
PaymentOptimizationResponse.description: Ways to need less credit, best first. Calculated, never from the model.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: Credit facility the Liquidity Agent proposes for a baseline shortfall.

StressTestResponse.title: StressTestResponse
StressTestResponse.description: Worst cases for the forecast and the extra credit they would need. Calculated, never from the model.

WhatIf.title: WhatIf
WhatIf.description: The change the question asked about, recalculated by the application.
